closed_note: verified on the re-run: 17 actuations in the 28-day gate window and 55 in a 180-day supplementary run, all six overflows opening on sim level and sim discharge, every event carrying its driver in evidence/OVERFLOWS.jsonl
detail: two independent causes. (1) the tidal crest was set 0.15 m above local MHWS, above the astronomical maximum the sim can produce, so no tide could ever reach it. (2) the storm series peaked at 3.2x DWF; a capacity weir at 0.75 x section height needs about 12x DWF to surcharge the egg, so it could never spill.
fix: crest derived from the geometry and placed between MHWN and MHWS (C-013); storm series rebuilt to combined-sewer practice, 2-6x ordinary and 8-25x on about one rain day in ten (C-014); depth table extended to 41x DWF. Actuations now occur and every event carries its driver in evidence/OVERFLOWS.jsonl.
